name: Hitomi Kanahito
source:
An energetic girl who never knows when to quit, Hitomi is by far the liveliest member of the group. Her positive demeanor and laid-back lifestyle make her very easy to talk to, but one might be surprised to find that there's a deeper and more somber side to the pint-sized superstar.

Hitomi spent much of her youth as an introvert, taking a particular interest in old films. Eventually, she grew past this, learning how to get by as a functional member of society. However, despite her outgoing personality, she has never been able to really understand the feelings of others.

Having recently moved to the city, Hitomi struggles to get by alone. It's her first time living on her own, and she's easily overwhelmed. Hoping to find new friends, and hoping to find direction through these bonds, Hitomi has joined the Human Reignition Project.
